baseline: Train rows only, seasonal months, event flag exactly 0; missing event flags excluded
target: Y1 = 100 * (event-day TS_AT - Train seasonal normal-day baseline) / baseline
missing_input_policy: Keep missing during feature construction; numeric median and categorical most-frequent imputation are fit separately on each disaster/feature-set Train rows only.
flow_feature: Monthly weekday flow-population values summed over matching 50m BLOCK_CD cells; selected by date month and weekday. This is a monthly weekday profile, not a daily observed count.
flow_region_link: BLOCK_CD first-five-character prefix mapping 11230->Gangnam-gu and 32010->Chuncheon-si; no exact merchant/block spatial crosswalk is present.
interpretation_note: Predictive explanation and permutation importance are not causal evidence. Y1 uses Train normal-day means; flow is a monthly weekday profile, not a daily observed flow count.

stability_assessment_thresholds.train_only_fit: Train MAE at least 15% lower than both validation and test, and Train R2 exceeds both by >=0.20
stability_assessment_thresholds.validation_to_test_drop: Test MAE > Validation MAE by 15% and Validation R2 exceeds Test R2 by >=0.15
stability_assessment_thresholds.train_to_validation_drop: Validation MAE > Train MAE by 15% and Train R2 exceeds Validation R2 by >=0.15
stability_assessment_thresholds.note: Descriptive flags with explicit thresholds; review the numeric metrics rather than treating labels as model selection.

shap_analysis: Not run: SHAP and its supporting packages are absent. Permutation importance is included.
